messages:
elaine: Heads-up — brought up quantized reranker v2 on staging (int8 hybrid). Eval harness shows NDCG@10 down ~3.2% vs float baseline on our gold set. MRR down ~1.1%. :frowning_face:

samir: ugh. Any obvious cohort where it drops more?

elaine: short queries (<6 tokens) and mixed-case queries look worst. Longform seems fine. Example: 'How to parse JSON in Go' dropped from 0.72 -> 0.65 NDCG contribution.

tomas: can you paste the eval command and model hash?

elaine: sure — run we used:
```
./eval_rerank.py --model sha:abc1234-quant-v2 --holdout goldset_v3 --metrics ndcg,mrr --seed 42 --preproc cfg=staging.v2
```

elaine: model hash and deploy event: sha:abc1234-quant-v2
deploy-bot: Model sha:abc1234-quant-v2 deployed to staging (pool: rerank-staging-3) by elaine at 2026-03-21T18:02:10Z.

anya: did the preproc change between float and quant eval? casing/normalization config sometimes slips in deploys.

elaine: preproc config was supposed to be identical (staging.v2). I diffed the JSON and found one key: `preserve_case: false` in the quant eval config vs `true` in baseline. Not sure if that came from the packaging step.

samir: that's huge. Lowercasing differences could change tokenization alignment and KV cache slices during serving. Could explain short-query sensitivity.

tomas: quick test: re-run eval with explicit lowercase on baseline and quant to check impact. Also run tokenizer tokens for the failing queries to see token boundary shifts.

elaine: did that, results:
```
baseline float (preserve_case=true): ndcg@10=0.885
quant (preserve_case=false): ndcg@10=0.857
quant (preserve_case=true): ndcg@10=0.883
```

elaine: so when quant uses same casing preproc, the gap mostly disappears. MRR mirrors that.

anya: nice catch. Remind me how configs end up different — is it in build-time packaging or runtime flag?

elaine: looks like our packaging script for quant artifacts injects a canonical preproc to normalize unknown vocab interactions; it's probably intended for some legacy clients but not for this eval.

samir: two immediate actions: 1) revert packaging override for eval builds, 2) add unit test that asserts preproc parity between float and quant artifacts for a given model name.

tomas: +1. Also add a small tokenizer parity smoke: feed 200 chars random samples and assert token ids equal after preproc. That would've caught this.

elaine: will open PRs. Also curious: does quantization itself change casing sensitivity even with same preproc? any residual delta?

samir: still possible: int8 rounding can affect attention score ordering on very tight ties. But given your numbers (0.885 vs 0.883) it's within noise once preproc is matched. We should still run a seed sweep and bootstrapped CI to be safe.

elaine: plan I propose:
- revert packaging override and re-deploy quant to staging (quick patch)
- run eval suite with 10 random seeds, bootstrap CI for NDCG and MRR
- add preproc parity test in infra repo
- run targeted short-query slice ablation and produce per-query diffs for top 200 regressions

anya: sounds good. I'll owner the infra test.

tomas: I'll help with the seed-sweep and bootstrap script. We should capture per-query tokenization diffs and embed them in the eval artifact (small CSV) so we can triage quickly next time.

elaine: PRs incoming. Quick question — should we also run a hybrid quant (4-bit outlier) build? last time that reduced accuracy errors on small queries.

samir: yes, include a quant variant and label in eval results. We need to track cost delta vs quality — add latency/cost columns too.

deploy-bot: Patch deploy requested by elaine — re-deploy queued to staging pool rerank-staging-3 (ETA 12m).

anya: can we add a guard in the rollout job: if ndcg delta > 1.0% on goldset_v3 then stop automatic rollout?

samir: we have a policy but it's not wired into the quant pipeline. Let's file a ticket (INF-2473) and add a quick stop-gap check on the staging publish step.

elaine: filing INF-2473 now. Thanks all — will post results here when re-eval finishes. :thumbsup:
